rationale: Unresolved design questions about motion vocabulary surface and transition overlapping would alter the core schema and API, combined with persistent animation properties in layer objects.

signals.blast_radius: New motion package with ~10 source files plus integration with core schema (layer/scene), renderer (transition composition, track evaluation), and timeline chunking; structural edits to layer schema for animated properties.
signals.unresolved: Five open questions: how much motion vocabulary Claude gets (presets-only vs raw keyframes vs opt-in flag), whether core requires stable ids for shared-element transitions, where cost diagnostics fire in the pipeline, whether transitions overlap scene boundaries, and spring baking vs live integration.
signals.irreversibility: Schema changes to core layer objects persist animated properties in existing specs; reverting requires spec migration or orphaning new fields.
